system.description:
Any Scriptures you have acquired are treated as having a SR of +1 (even if it exceeds the maximum SR).
If you have not acquired it, it is treated as having SR 1.
You cannot equip more than one of these items at the same time.
[Trigger: Action] Use this at the same time as your Resurrection. Remove one BS from the target of Resurrection.

A ring said to have been worn by a group of famous healers in the ancient dynasty. The prayers put into it strengthen the healing power used by the wearer.

Catalyst Flask [Core Material] (60G) + Transparent Ring (110G) + [Magic Catalyst 5] (40G) x 4 + Crafting Cost (210G)
